request.input:
2girls, artist:gray domain, manga, monochrome, high complexity, text, chinese text, very aesthetic, amazing quality. A single portrait manga page with five main panels and one bordered inset, six panels in total. A shallow wide establishing panel spans the top. In the middle band, a narrow tall panel on the left spans the combined height of two smaller horizontal panels stacked on the right. One large wide closing panel spans the bottom. A small phone-detail inset is embedded in the upper-left corner of this closing panel, leaving the closing speaker's face and speech bubble unobstructed on the right. Read the top panel first, then the tall middle-left panel, the upper middle-right panel, the lower middle-right panel, the phone inset, and finally the large closing panel. Use clearly visible gutters between main panels; the inset is the only intentional overlap. Panel identifiers are planning labels and are not printed in the artwork. The scene is a cozy band rehearsal room. The same Chihaya Anon appears in the top panel and both small middle-right panels; the same Nagasaki Soyo appears in the tall middle-left panel and the large closing panel. The inset shows Anon's smartphone gallery, not a new person. Their clothes and appearances remain consistent. A guitar on a stand, an amplifier, and acoustic wall panels establish the continuous setting. Expressive faces and subtle comedic timing. Leave generous white space in speech bubbles for clear horizontal Chinese lettering.
Text: 素世，我练到手都酸啦！

哦？
今天练了几首？

四十五张……

啊，你问练琴啊。

难怪。
酸的是举手机那只手吧。

char_captions.char_caption: In the shallow full-width top panel, medium shot: girl, chihaya_anon, long pink hair, blue eyes, white oversized hoodie. Anon proudly rubs her right wrist with her left hand, with a bright self-satisfied smile as she talks to Soyo outside the panel. Her untouched electric guitar rests on a stand behind her. A spacious speech bubble on the right belongs to Anon and reads "素世，我练到手都酸啦！".

In the narrow middle-left panel spanning both middle rows, medium close-up: girl, nagasaki_soyo, long light brown hair, green eyes, beige knitted cardigan over a white blouse. Soyo tilts her head slightly and looks toward Anon outside the panel with gentle curiosity. The tall narrow panel has room above her head for a white speech bubble. The bubble belongs to Soyo and reads "哦？
今天练了几首？".

In the small upper middle-right panel, facial close-up: girl, chihaya_anon, long pink hair, blue eyes, white oversized hoodie. Anon enthusiastically blurts out a number with a confident open-mouthed smile. A small speech bubble belonging to Anon reads "四十五张……".

In the small lower middle-right panel directly below the previous Anon close-up, facial close-up: girl, chihaya_anon, long pink hair, blue eyes, white oversized hoodie. Her smile freezes into an embarrassed sheepish expression, with a small sweat drop on her cheek, as she realizes Soyo meant guitar practice. A speech bubble belonging to Anon reads "啊，你问练琴啊。".

Inside the small bordered phone inset embedded in the upper-left corner of the large bottom panel, extreme close-up: a smartphone screen displaying a grid of repeated selfies of the same pink-haired Anon posing beside her guitar. Only the smartphone, the edge of a hand and a white hoodie sleeve fill this small inset. Silent object detail, without a speech bubble or readable interface labels. The inset is contained inside the bottom panel and leaves Soyo's face and dialogue clear on its right.

In the large full-width bottom closing panel surrounding the small phone inset, close-up: girl, nagasaki_soyo, long light brown hair, green eyes, beige knitted cardigan over a white blouse. Soyo rests her cheek on one hand, giving Anon a knowing, gently teasing smile with half-lidded eyes. Her face occupies the right half of this wide panel; leave the upper-left area for the separate bordered phone inset. A spacious speech bubble above and to the right of Soyo belongs to her and reads "难怪。
酸的是举手机那只手吧。".
